[[File:Pirate_asteroid_base.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A pirate asteroid base.]]
'''Asteroid bases''' were [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] built into [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. Many groups used such bases, including pirates, smugglers as well as legitimate commercial or scientific concerns. They also saw some private use, such as [[Void Station]] acting as a private retreat for the [[Bothan]] [[Jib Kopatha]]. In addition, some were also retrofitted to act as bases, such as the [[Asteroid Hangar]]s developed by [[Byblos Drive Yards/Legends|Byblos Drive Yards]], originally acting as mining areas.

The criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] owned [[Hutt asteroid station|several asteroid bases]].<ref name="Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref> The Galactic Empire in its various forms also possessed Asteroid bases, including the [[Cairn Installation]] utilized by the [[Empire Reborn]]<ref name="Jedi Knight II">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref> and the Byblos Drive Yards-developed [[To-phalion Base]]<ref name="Defender of the Empire">''[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire]]''</ref> and [[Falken's Lab]]<ref name="The Phantom Affair">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Phantom Affair]]''</ref> utilized by the pre-Endor Galactic Empire. The Rebel Alliance also owned some asteroid bases, such as the [[Asteroid base (Kashyyyk system)|one]] in the Kashyyyk system.<ref name="Renegade Squad">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> [[StarForge Station]] was also a haven for various outlaws in the galaxy.<ref name="Scum and Villainy">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> [[Station Gamma]], formerly owned by the [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das smugglers]] as a research center, was utilized by the [[Rak'qua]] tribe as a [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]]<ref name="SWG:SG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Station Gamma}}</ref> The [[Vergesso Base]] was a shadowport for the Rebel Alliance, although it was formally owned by the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]].<ref name="SotE novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadow of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> The resort [[The Edge of the Galaxy]] contained an asteroid installation.<ref name="Star Tours novel">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>
